subject: Computação
description_pt: Analisar programas para detectar e remover erros, ampliando a confiança na sua correção. Construir e analisar soluções computacionais de problemas de diferentes áreas do conhecimento, de forma individual ou colaborativa, selecionando as estruturas de dados adequadas (registros, matrizes, listas e grafos), aperfeiçoando e articulando saberes escolares.

components.description_pt: Identificar e corrigir erros lógicos em algoritmo que impedem resolver o problema pretendido
components.description_en: Identify and correct logical errors in a given algorithm that prevent it from solving the intended problem
components.cc_component_description: Identify and correct logical errors in a given algorithm that prevent it from solving the intended problem

components.description_pt: Remover erros identificados de programa para aumentar confiança em sua correção
components.description_en: Remove identified errors from a program to increase confidence in its correctness
components.cc_component_description: Identify and correct logical errors in a given algorithm that prevent it from solving the intended problem

components.description_pt: Explicar como processos de depuração melhoram confiabilidade de solução computacional
components.description_en: Explain how debugging processes improve the reliability of a computational solution
components.cc_component_description: Revise an experimental design to improve the quality or reliability of collected data

cc_matches.description: Create algorithms (a series of ordered steps) to solve a problem.
Conduct an investigation and/or evaluate and/or revise the experimental design to produce data to serve as the basis for evidence that meet the goals of the investigation.
